11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager has spent months preparing for a difficult task.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) has spent months preparing for a difficult task. Today is finally the day. (He/She) has practiced, studied, and imagined this moment so many times that it hardly seems real. Yet now that the moment has arrived, (name1) feels strangely calm.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (name1) takes a deep breath and starts. The task proves challenging, but familiar. By evening (he/she) has made a respectable beginning. There is still much to do, and (name1) feels ready to continue.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (name1) sits quietly for a few minutes, watching the village go about its business. Then (he/she) stands and begins. The delay changes nothing important, but (name1) is glad to have taken it.
